text:
maya: Hey folks — can someone take a quick look at my PR? Dashboard threshold logic + small trace hook change. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4823. TL;DR: reduce alerts noise by making error rate alert use 5m rolling avg and add trace tag for service.version. Also updated metrics schema. Need approvals + want to merge before EOD if CI is green.

jon: On it. Will skim now, should take ~20m.

priya: Adding to queue. Quick Q: did you run the metrics-backfill script locally? Concern about the tag rename breaking sums.

maya: I ran it against a staging snapshot, no regressions. Command I used: `./scripts/backfill_metrics --to-tag service.version --since=24h`. I can attach the logs after I push a test fix.

alex: CI failing on unit tests in metrics-serializer. Error:```
E   AssertionError: expected 3 tags, got 2
...tests/test_serializer.py:45
```
Looks like the new field isn't being emitted in the mocked registry.

maya: ack — fixing test now.

dev-bot: CI status: tests/platform on PR #4823 — failed (unit). details: https://ci.redwood.com/build/12345

liam: heads-up: if this touches the metrics schema we should coordinate with ops for the canary. @maya what's the rollout plan?

maya: plan: canary 5% for 1h, monitor error/latency + dash panels (https://dash.redwood.com/d/metrics-qa). If no regressions, then 100% after 2h. I'll open a canary rollout ticket in the runbook.

priya: left a comment on the serializer test; small nit on fixture. Will re-check after fix.

jon: also left a note about naming of the new trace tag (service.version vs service_version). prefer dot to keep consistent with other tags — pls align.

maya: changed to `service.version`, pushed new commit. PTAL. Once CI is green, can someone approve? @priya @jon

priya: LGTM once tests pass. :thumbsup:

jon: +1. Can approve after green.

dev-bot: CI status: tests/platform on PR #4823 — passed. https://ci.redwood.com/build/12347

maya: awesome, thanks! merging now. Will post a follow-up if anything odd during canary.
